facts.fact: The Civil Registry Department and ZEC began handing voter registration and voters' roll management to the Registrar-General, including Biometric Voter Registration (BVR) kits and network infrastructure, with continuous voter registration continuing.

A deputy chief secretary in the Office of the President and Cabinet says voter registration is being integrated into the national civil registration framework so that citizen data captured at the Registrar-General's office carries into the voters' roll.
Justice Minister Ziyambi said ZEC was already using the Registrar-General's national population database to clean up the voters' roll, since it shows who is alive, dead and of voting age.

note: Voter registration function returned to the Civil Registry; no digital roll stated.

facts.fact: The report says the Zimbabwe Electoral Commission maintains biometric voter databases.

Zimbabwe's electoral commission told voters in the August 2025 by-election wards to check their registration by the NetOne-only *265# code or online inspection, and says it displays the voters' roll two days before polling.
